description: The agent must: (1) Read the sales handoff file and messy status report to understand client context. (2) Generate onboarding_checklist.md using the proprietary checkbox format ('- [ ]') covering all 5 phases (pre-onboarding, Day 1, Week 1, Week 2-4, Day 30/60/90), with ownership fields and deadlines for each item, customized to the law firm/ContractIQ/MS365 context. (3) Generate welcome_sequence.md with all 6 specific emails (immediate welcome, Day 1 getting-started guide, Day 3 check-in, Day 7 tips, Day 14 milestone celebration, Day 30 feedback request), each ready-to-send with subject lines and greetings. (4) Generate risk_report.md that flags all 5 canonical risk types from the SKILL.md: missed milestones (weeks 1 and 2 both missed), low engagement signals (zero logins in 7 days), delayed responses (initial non-response, voicemail), scope creep (lease agreements and litigation hold workflows not in original contract), and champion departure (Tom Yuen potentially leaving). The key proprietary traps are: checkbox format (not numbered lists), mandatory ownership+deadlines on every checklist item, all 6 emails not just a generic sequence, and identifying all 5 specific risk taxonomy items from the raw status dump.
